Faults: (1) the five swap transitions between continuing cards (3.30, 31.50, 47.75, 55.20, 63.00 s) mask the old line up out of a baseline clip so its descenders and punctuation stay behind for ~6 frames on an otherwise empty headline slot: crop/swap-3433.png (g, y tails and the red full stop), crop/swap-31633.png (the red g of 'replay' plus four black fragments); regenerate with `ffmpeg -ss 3.433 -i vsl-90s.mp4 -frames:v 1 -vf crop=1600:300:160:200`; (2) inside every wipe the new card's first word starts at 403 ms and the wipe runs 650 ms, so each cut shows ~0.4-1.0 s of bare paper right of the playhead (tr/t19850.png tiles 2-6, tr/t66950.png tiles 3-7); (3) one device at one speed, one direction and one ease, 15 times, with no change of weight for the two story rewinds (b05, b14); the slow push is 2.2 percent over a card and is not perceptible, so the last 1-2 s of most cards are static holds (b07: a 3.95 s type card whose only motion is the word rise); (4) during every wipe two Record playheads are on screen, the ruler's and the wipe's (tr/t23300.png tile 4); (5) the end-card wipe leaves a near-empty Reel frame with one line of words at the top from 85.4 to ~86.3 s (crop/end-85600.png, blk/end-wipe-30fps.png; blackdetect 85.533-85.767). audio.evidence: Correct per brief: one aac stream, stereo, 48 kHz, no voice, music only, -16.0 LUFS integrated, no clipping (flat factor 0, peak -4.9 dBFS), no silence gaps, 1.5 s fade at the end, no cross-cut clicks other than the designed ticks. Not release grade: the bed is score() in render.py, a four-chord sine pad (Am F C G, 84 BPM) with a soft octave and a low root, a noise click every quarter note (126 of them at ~-25 dB high-band peak, a/hp.txt), a firmer click on every card change and three 0.7 s falling sweeps; the spectrogram (a/spec.png) shows no musical energy above ~700 Hz, a level step at every bar from the per-bar envelope, and the ticks as the only transients; LRA 0.6 LU and a momentary span that never moves with the story (no lift under the hook or b14, no drop under the concept cards). The first card-change click fires at sample 0, the loudest transient in the film (-13 dBFS >4 kHz peak at 0.00 s), which many players will pass as a pop on play. For a film whose only sound is this bed, a generated sine pad with a metronome is placeholder quality.
